metadata.purpose: Quantify that all source values satisfy an indexed predicate, short-circuiting on the first falsy result.

conditions: On successful finite completion emit true once, including the empty input (vacuous truth).
On first falsy result emit false once and complete early; source error, callback throw or cancellation never emits a boolean.
Cω counts next values; terminal notifications, resource release and cancellation are separate obligations.

scope.parameters: Required synchronous indexed predicate; without thisArg overload.
scope.callbacks: Synchronous predicate (value,index,source), represented as a correlated invocation/outcome pair; user code is not executed by model.
scope.time: No clock; predicate return is a synchronous logical microstep. Completion or first falsy result determines output time.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant source and callback outcome delivery; no observer/finalizer reentry inside the modeled reaction.
exclusions: thisArg overload and user callback reentrancy.

initialization.sourceSubscription: One independently owned source connection is acquired at subscription, not construction.

ownership.sharing: None; independent operator state per subscription even if the upstream happens to be shared.
ownership.reset: Fresh subscription starts with new state; closed execution rejects all subsequent model inputs.

resources.owner: one correlated external callback per tested input

dispatch.actionSemantics: Evaluate exactly one predicate for each reached source next; do not emit on success; false immediately ends the execution.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between source notifications or completed synchronous logical microsteps; silent release only.
